correctness.rationale: The formal identity uses P’(1/t) reciprocal coefficients and Vieta, so repeated roots are included. Algebraic coefficient extraction has a noncancelling multinomial expansion. The Hessian has one nonzero per reflected-gap row; summing gap indicators proves its rank 2gamma-F-1, while its blocks yield the stated inertia. For pseudo-symmetry, all noncentral reciprocal exponents lie in the semigroup, and only two central exponents can sum to F, giving -F c_h^2/8. F=1 is handled. Exact-rational independent companion-matrix checks: 276 semigroups, 828 coefficient examples, and 207 interpolated Hessian entries.

value.rationale: This is a complete evaluation, for every numerical semigroup and arbitrary gap coefficients, of the natural trace over critical values studied in the motivating paper. It supplies a noncancelling support formula, an exact analytic encoding of the Frobenius-genus symmetry defect and Hessian inertia, a sharp pseudo-symmetric full-family identity, and symmetry/ordinariness characterizations. These structural invariants connect numerical semigroup gap reflection to sparse polynomial critical-point behavior and are not arbitrary numerical slices.
